## 2026-09-09 — Authorized internal-lane and E2 measurement repair

- **Goal:** Complete internal-lane accounting, define and verify named-lane E2 observation targets, implement the minimum observation-only change and check a matched trajectory.
- **Work performed:** Added explicit internal/external FCD lane groups, unknown/duplicate/missing-lane checks and separately reconciled instantaneous lane/group counters. Runtime E2 extents now use compiled lane endpoints; source XML retains a non-extending endPos=-0.1 fallback. An isolated no-step TraCI probe confirmed 238.80 m shared-lane and 204.49 m storage-lane coverage with unchanged probe-source hashes. Geometry, priorities, signals, demand, behavior and controller settings were unchanged.
- **Files changed:** `config/scenarios/minimal_uncontrolled/scenario.add.xml`, its README, `src/scenarios/run_minimal_uncontrolled.py`, new `src/scenarios/check_e2_coverage.py`, new `src/analysis/internal_lane_accounting.py`, associated tests and derived reports under `data/processed/stage2_internal_accounting_20260909/`; updated root README, PROJECT_STATE, STAGE2_TIMING_DIAGNOSTIC and this log. No decisions, protocol, agent rules or dashboard changed.
- **Commands and verification:** One representative matched technical run `/private/tmp/minimal_uncontrolled_8egb0qb1` against retained `/private/tmp/minimal_uncontrolled_eozyn46f`; seed 17, qMain/qRamp=3200/720 veh/h and 600/900/1200 s phases solely to match the reference. Probe evidence is `/private/tmp/e2_coverage_probe_minimal_uncontrolled_8egb0qb1.json`. Independent `paired_semantic_comparison_v3.json` found zero differences in 2700 FCD timestep records, 1858 tripinfo records, 2700 TLS records and four E1 files of 90 intervals each. Python compilation, 17/17 unit/integration tests and whitespace checks passed. Engineer implemented and tested; data analyst independently reconciled; scientific reviewer passed all five measurement checks within technical scope.
- **Outcome:** Measurement repair complete, not Stage 2. Audited FCD accounting has no unknown lane/ID, duplicate or malformed observations. Added internal-lane stopping samples recover observations excluded by earlier ordinary-edge summaries. The repaired paired case records the same traffic, not improved traffic.
- **Problems and limitations:** Review caught mixed lane/group counters in v1 and an initial comparison that did not establish across-run equality; both were corrected and regression-checked. Authoritative reports are `accounting_v2.json`, `low_accounting_v2.json`, `paired_accounting_v2.json` and `paired_semantic_comparison_v3.json`. Earlier reports and the new run's original summary remain preserved; its old instantaneous accounting fields are superseded by the v2 overlay. Legacy 250 m E2 successor chains remain unknown and old/new E2 values have different spatial meanings. Single-pair equality is not general invariance, model realism, causal extra delay or capacity evidence. Temporary runtime directories are not a permanent formal archive.
- **Next step:** Return to bounded timing and accumulation diagnosis using repaired observations and reliable dynamic visual inspection. No phase durations, storage capacity, formal thresholds, demand grid, ALINEA or override were selected by this repair.

## 2026-09-09 — Approved targeted S3–S5 internal-E1 validation

- **Authorization:** User approved the G1-v2 D7 proposal and asked when S3–S5 would execute. Work proceeded immediately as the approved targeted S3–S5. Budget: one matched exploratory SUMO run and at most one same-parameter retry only for a localized detector load/write failure; no GUI, TraCI probe, other seed or demand point.
- **S3 implementation:** Added two observation-only E1 loops at 4.32 m on M-only internal lanes `:freeway_merge_1_0/1`. Runner validation now checks source/runtime mapping, compiled lane length/position/connections, six E1 outputs and a separate `mainline_merge_entry` group; the old upstream group is labelled `origin_insertion_contaminated`. Network, routes, demand, TLS, seed, insertion and vehicle behavior were unchanged.
- **S4 run:** `/private/tmp/minimal_uncontrolled__5s3s06d` completed under SUMO/netconvert 1.26.0. Actual SUMO starts: one; retries: zero. No warning, error, collision, teleport, emergency braking or route error. Relative to `/private/tmp/minimal_uncontrolled_8egb0qb1`, semantic differences were zero for 2700 FCD timesteps, 1858 tripinfo records, 2700 TLS records, 1858 vehroute records and 90 intervals for each old E1.
- **S5 analysis:** Added `src/analysis/validate_internal_e1.py`, `tests/test_internal_e1_analysis.py`, processed validation evidence and two tables. New E1 lanes each contain 90 continuous intervals. Full contributions are 715+618=1333; A `[0,1500)` is 1331 contributions, 3194.4 veh/h and 30.8728 m/s; B `[300,1500)` is 1066, 3198.0 veh/h and 30.8290 m/s. Seventy-eight no-contribution speed intervals remain missing. Ordinary E1 lacks vehID, so per-vehicle omission/duplication remains not verified; 1 Hz FCD observed only 321 IDs on the short internal lanes and was not used as a complete list.
- **Verification:** Engineer tests 9 passed, analyst tests 4 passed, and primary combined rerun 13 passed. Independent analysis reconciled 180 E1 rows × 7 fields and recomputed eight lane/window summaries. Source/artifact hashes remained stable. Scientific review passed target and declared-section coverage, passed aggregate reconciliation and contract regression protection, and accepted interval coverage while retaining per-ID completeness as not verified. No Blocker/Major remains for this bounded technical milestone.
- **Documentation:** Added `docs/STAGE2_S3_S4_ENGINEERING_REPORT.md` and `docs/STAGE2_S3_S5_VALIDATION_REPORT.md`; updated G1/Stage2 status, PROJECT_STATE, README and this worklog. DECISIONS, EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL, supervisor records and unrelated changes were preserved.

## 2026-09-09 — Approved Stage 2 C0–C5 completion batch and G2 package

- **Authorization:** User approved C0–C5 of `docs/STAGE2_COMPLETION_PLAN.md`, including the fixed C/ML/MH/RL matrix, seeds 17/23, 0/1500/1200-second windows, seven normal new runs and at most one same-parameter technical retry. No added point, seed, duration, ALINEA, GUI or formal experiment was authorized.
- **C0–C1:** Established `stage2_completion_20260909_v1`, archived the retained C17 runtime byte-for-byte, and added a strict archive-only analysis entry point. The individual flow schedule remains unverified because the old nominal formula differs from observed C17 M scheduled times by up to 0.379437 s. Twenty-five offline tests and independent C17/revision_02 checks passed. Scientific review accepted the C1 measurement contract.
- **C2:** Ran C23, ML17, ML23, MH17, MH23, RL17 and RL23 sequentially. Actual new SUMO starts were seven of the hard limit eight; retries were zero. All used SUMO/netconvert 1.26.0, completed with no registered warning/error/collision/teleport/emergency/route error, produced six continuous 90-interval E1 series, and eventually inserted and completed every planned vehicle. Each 29-file runtime was atomically archived with stable per-file SHA-256. A pre-C23 outer shell redirection failure occurred before Python/netconvert/SUMO started and was logged without consuming the run or retry budget.
- **C3:** Final revision_04 preserves revision_03's five CSV tables byte-identically and standardizes the two figures' axes. Independent checks reconciled 232 archived files, 14,564 run-vehicle rows, 4,320 E1 rows, 2,912 cohort rows, 4,200 R merge-event endpoints and 198 same-seed contrasts. All eight runs cleared by 2700 s; substantial R/U insertion after 1500 s means the post window is not zero-inflow recovery.
- **Findings:** Lower mainline demand increased demand-period R downstream observations and reduced R/U outside counts in both seeds. Higher mainline demand yielded zero demand-period R downstream observations in both seeds while mainline passage remained high; this is not a capacity or system-improvement conclusion. Lower ramp demand strongly reduced endpoint outside counts and increased U arrivals, but did not consistently improve mainline speed or materially increase R demand-period downstream observations.
- **C4–C5:** Scientific review passed all five measurement checks within the declared exploratory scope and found no Blocker, Major or required Minor. Exact schedule timing, mid-run outside-waiting curves, ordinary-E1 per-ID completeness, steady state, capacity, Breakdown, Capacity Drop and statistical robustness remain unverified. Added `docs/STAGE2_COMPLETION_REPORT.md` with `next_step_readiness=ready_for_next_exploration` and `stage2_acceptance=pending_user`.

# Stage 2 timing diagnostic — exploratory

Date: 2026-09-09. Status: descriptive audit only; no timing parameter selected.

## Evidence and provenance

The data analyst independently checked raw tripinfo, FCD and E1 XML in the five retained runtime directories below. Raw files were not modified. All runs used seed 17; no independent stochastic replication is represented here.

| Runtime under `/private/tmp/` | Warm-up / measurement / maximum clearance (s) | Requested main / ramp (veh/h) | Ramp actual measurement departures (veh/h) | Ramp / urban departures during clearance | Last arrival (s) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `minimal_uncontrolled_17p2c9eo` | 600 / 600 / 900 | 1080 / 360 | 360 | 0 / 0 | 1271 |
| `minimal_uncontrolled_vbpsz_99` | 600 / 600 / 900 | 2600 / 600 | 360 | 40 / 24 | 1670 |
| `minimal_uncontrolled_zk23w8q3` | 600 / 600 / 900 | 3200 / 720 | 156 | 94 / 47 | 1883 |
| `minimal_uncontrolled_d73b4m7x` | 300 / 600 / 600 | 3200 / 720 | 462 | 43 / 22 | 1385 |
| `minimal_uncontrolled_eozyn46f` | 600 / 900 / 1200 | 3200 / 720 | 120 | 150 / 75 | 2401 |

All scheduled vehicles eventually entered and arrived. This is not evidence of demand realization during measurement: vehicles waiting outside the network can enter during clearance. Clearance stops new scheduled demand, not necessarily actual insertion.
